description: SurrealDB built-in functions, one entry per function. scripts/generate-functions.mjs generates src/functions/generated/ from this table; test/functions-engine.test.ts calls every entry with its sample arguments on each engine.

fields.name: the SurrealQL name
fields.args: each argument: name, kind, and optional (only trailing arguments); the last one repeats when variadic
fields.variadic: the last argument takes any number of values, none included
fields.result: the kind of the result; same:N is the codec of argument N, item:N an element of argument N (an array) or NONE, float|decimal:N,M a float, or a float or a decimal when one of arguments N, M (or an element of it) may hold a decimal
fields.engines: the SurrealDB majors the function exists in, as measured
fields.sample: SurrealQL text for each argument of the conformance call
fields.variants: more argument sets the conformance test calls on every listed engine, each of whose results must decode with the codec the function derives (a numeric literal argument has the codec of its own kind)
fields.setup: SurrealQL the conformance call needs first

kinds: any string int int64 float number decimal bool datetime duration uuid bytes record object geometry range array array<K> option<K>

functions.name: search::analyze
functions.setup: DEFINE ANALYZER IF NOT EXISTS functions_simple TOKENIZERS blank FILTERS lowercase;
